properties.name: udiv32_magic_differential
properties.formal: ∀ d ∈ u32 divisors (edge-skewed), ∀ x ∈ u32 edges, ∀ shape ∈ {U32Native, U32InI64}: interp(div_by_const_function(f[x /u d])) = x /u d

properties.name: sdiv32_magic_differential
properties.formal: ∀ d ∈ ±{2..2^31} ∪ {INT_MIN}, ∀ x ∈ i32 edges, ∀ shape ∈ {I32Native, I32InI64}: interp(div_by_const_function(f[x /s d])) = trunc_i32(x /s d)

properties.name: rem_by_const_differential
properties.formal: ∀ op ∈ {SRem,URem}, ∀ d ≠ 0 (|d| ≤ 2^31, unsigned-pow2 and magic-missing carve-outs excluded from must-rewrite), ∀ x edges: interp(div_by_const_function(f[x op d])) = C11_rem(x, d)

properties.name: div64_genuine_i128_differential
properties.formal: ∀ op ∈ {UDiv,SDiv}, ∀ d edge-skewed 64-bit, ∀ x edge-skewed 64-bit: interp(div_by_const_function(f[x op d])) = wrapping div/rem at 64 bits

properties.name: fold_matches_c11_model
properties.formal: ∀ E ∈ all-const DAGs over I8..U64 (well-typed Value uses, sign-matched cmps, no div-by-zero): fold∘copy_prop to fixpoint leaves Return = Const(interp(E))
properties.counterexample: I8 DAG LShr(Const(I8(-72)), Const(I8(1)), I8): fold gives -36, C11 requires 92

properties.name: fold_div_by_zero_not_folded
properties.formal: ∀ op ∈ {SDiv,UDiv,SRem,URem}, ∀ ty ∈ {I32,I64}: fold_function leaves BinOp{op, rhs=Const(0)} present (UB preserved)

properties.name: simplify_identity_metamorphic
properties.formal: ∀ E, ∀ inj ∈ README identity table: interp(simplify_function(inject(E, inj))) = interp(E)

properties.name: simplify_strength_reduction_value
properties.formal: ∀ sr ∈ strength reductions, ∀ k, ∀ x edges, ∀ ty: interp(simplify_function(f[sr(x,k)])) = interp(f[plain(x,k)])

properties.name: gvn_copy_prop_preservation
properties.formal: ∀ E with duplicated subexpressions, ∀ args: interp(gvn∘copy_prop(E), args) = interp(E, args) ∧ insts(after) ≤ insts(before)

properties.name: dce_preservation
properties.formal: ∀ E, ∀ dead pure chains: interp(dce(E ++ dead)) = interp(E) ∧ count decreases

properties.name: cfg_simplify_preservation_and_reachability
properties.formal: ∀ G random CFGs, ∀ args: interp(simplify_cfg(G)) = interp(G) ∧ all blocks reachable ∧ targets in range

properties.name: narrow_preservation
properties.formal: ∀ pat ∈ {phase-1 widen-operate-narrow (whitelisted ops), phase-2 I64 bitwise of provably-32-bit operands, phase-3 sign-matched cmps}: interp(narrow_function(f[pat]), args) = interp(f[pat], args); unsigned cmps on signed source asserted NOT rewritten
properties.counterexample: f(a:i32,b:i32)->i64 { Or(sext a, sext b) at I64 } narrowed to Or@I32 with no re-extension; f(1,-1)=4294967295 != -1 (pipeline-confirmed)

properties.name: pipeline_value_preservation
properties.formal: ∀ shape ∈ {linear, diamond, loop, random CFG, div32}, ∀ args: interp(run_passes(shape), args) = interp(shape, args); no panic

bugs.summary: constant_fold sign-extends sub-int operands before logical ops (LShr/UDiv/URem at I8/I16 fold wrong)
bugs.impact: latent silent miscompile: I8/I16-typed logical shifts / unsigned div-rem of negative constants fold to wrong constants; narrow Phase 1 can create those instruction shapes and the pipeline re-runs constant_fold afterwards
bugs.expected: LShr((I8)0xB8, 1) folds to 92 (logical shift of the 8-bit pattern)
bugs.actual: folds to -36 — the is_32bit fast path's `as u32` sign-extends 0xB8 to 0xFFFFFFB8 before the logical op
bugs.counterexample: d = LShr(Const(I8(-72)), Const(I8(1)), I8); return d  →  fold: I8(-36), C11: 92
bugs.fix: In fold_binop's is_32bit logical arms, zero-extend the sub-int operand pattern (mask to the operand type's width before widening); AShr's as i32 is promotion-correct and can stay; same for UDiv/URem arms

bugs.summary: narrow Phase 2 rewrites I64 bitwise ops to I32 without checking the use — I64 consumers get the zero-extended value (pipeline miscompile)
bugs.impact: run_passes(-O2, x86-64) compiles f(a,b){(i64)a | (i64)b} to return the zero-extended 32-bit Or: f(1,-1) = 4294967295 instead of -1; And/Xor share the code path
bugs.expected: pipeline preserves the interpreted value: sext(a)|sext(b) = -1 for (1,-1)
bugs.actual: Or rewritten to I32 with no re-extension; the I64 return reads 4294967295
bugs.counterexample: fn f(a: i32, b: i32) -> i64 { Or(Cast a I32→I64, Cast b I32→I64, I64); Return } on (1, -1)
bugs.fix: Check the single use consumes the value in an I32/U32 context before rewriting (or emit Cast target_ty→I64 after the narrowed op)
bugs.documentedBehavior: "narrows I64 bitwise operations (And, Or, Xor) to I32 when all operands are provably 32-bit values ... restricted to I32/U32 output to avoid sub-int register complications" — src/passes/README.md Integer Narrowing, Phase 2
